text:
incident-bot: [PAGER] Sev2: Elevated quality regressions observed for model: rwd-text-002 in prod-us-east1 — error rate spiking, customers reporting hallucinations. Auto-alert triggered: 95th percentile response error rate +25% over baseline.
Maya (oncall): I’m looking. Pulling logs and traces now.
Tomas: I can confirm increased misclassification in the reranker step from the logs. Looks like last deploy at 1807499000 touched model routing.
Maya (oncall): @Tomas ok can you share the deploy sha and which variant was behind the traffic shift?
Tomas: deploy sha: abc1234, variant: rwd-text-002-v3-quant. Traffic shift at 12:30UTC.
Devin (ops): If we need quick mitigation we can pin traffic to rwd-text-002-v2 (previous stable) at the router layer. Quick command:
```
# pin model at routing layer
curl -X POST "$ROUTER_API/models/pin" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rwd-text-002","version":"v2","duration":3600}'
```
Maya (oncall): Good. I will run a pin and monitor. @Aisha please prep customer-facing note.
Aisha (CS): drafting. Suggest: "We observed an unexpected model behavior affecting a subset of requests; we're mitigating by rolling back traffic to the previous model version. No data loss. We'll update when fully verified." Want to include ETA?
Maya (oncall): ETA 30-45m for verification after pin.
Lydia (docs): I'll prepare a short status page snippet and keep the incident template handy.
incident-bot: Incident timeline recorded. Severity set to Sev2. Paging escalations enabled.
Maya (oncall): Executing pin now.
Maya (oncall): `> curl -X POST "$ROUTER_API/models/pin" ...` returned 200. Traffic shifted back to v2. Initial metrics look promising — error rate dropping.
Tomas: Confirming reranker error rate back to baseline in the last 3 mins. Good sign.
Aisha (CS): Customer notification draft: "We detected a regression after a recent model update which caused degraded outputs for some queries. We've routed traffic back to the previously serving model while we investigate. No customer data was exposed or lost. We will share a follow-up with root cause and timeline in the next 24 hours." Approve?
Maya (oncall): Approve. Add contact link to support@redwood.ai and status page link.
Devin (ops): We should create a short rollback PR to revert the deploy in the code repo to avoid accidental re-deploys. I can open it and tag @tomas.
Tomas: I'll own the postmortem and root cause analysis. Likely related to quantization kernel change; collecting artifacts.
Lydia (docs): Status page entry: "Mitigated — traffic pinned to rwd-text-002 v2; monitoring. Engineers investigating cause. No customer impact to persisted data. Next update in 2 hours."
incident-bot: Noted. Notification sent to status page and to all affected workspace customers.
Maya (oncall): Handoff: I need to go offline for 45m. @Devin please take on-call until 181 (next rotation) — leave the pin in place and continue monitoring.
Devin (ops): Taking over. I’ll keep charts up and set alert thresholds tighter for the next hour.
Aisha (CS): Sending customer note now. Will follow up with targeted emails for customers who reported issues.
Maya (oncall): Final note before handoff: preserve logs, snapshot the KV cache and model metrics at 12:30-13:15UTC for the RCA. Tagging incident for postmortem: owners: Tomas (RCA), Lydia (comms), Aisha (customer follow-up).
Tomas: Thanks. I’ll include model pinning guidance in the postmortem: when a variant shows quality regression, prefer pinning at routing + immediate revert of the model artifact in CI, avoid in-place quantization toggles without canary sample.
Devin (ops): Adding temporary runbook steps in the ops-runbook: pin-command, rollback-pr template, slack-notify snippet.
incident-bot: Incident moved to "Mitigated". Next update window in 2 hours.
Maya (oncall): back online, confirmed stable. Great job team.
Devin (ops): Will keep an eye. Closing channel update after 2h if stable.
Lydia (docs): Draft of customer postmortem and internal comms will be ready in ~6 hours for review.
Aisha (CS): Sent targeted follow-ups to impacted accounts. Kept messaging consistent with status page.
Tomas: I’ll push RCA draft tomorrow and include suggested CI guardrails to prevent this class of regression"
